quest.title: Ravaged by Wolves
quest.description: It seems that the "red, burny girl" was not Amber, as you had thought. But you receive news from Amber about wolf pack attacks in Drunkard Gorge. The wolf pack, the boy, the attacks... things are getting more complicated. This calls for a thorough investigation.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Oh dear... This is awful, poor lad can't even stand.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That's terrible!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Except... he's not actually injured...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Right. It's awful, the wolves frightened him so badly that he's paralyzed with fear.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That... really is awful.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Do you remember any significant details of what you saw?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: I—I've never seen a wolf in my life before today, it was terrifying...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: ...No details then, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Let's investigate the area again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These claw marks... This was more than just a couple of wolves. And... No friggin' way, they must have been two meters high!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These claw marks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: From them, we can tell the number and size of the wolves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This time there were at least two wolves, and they must be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Be what?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, yes! They must be at least... two meters high!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Paimon, you do know what a wolf is, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Wolves are mysterious creatures, it's not like you see them every day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a wolf's tooth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He must have smashed into the door when he pounced.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's calcium deficient.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, seems pretty lucky how no one in the village got seriously injured.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Wolf fur... I heard that in Liyue they make calligraphy brushes out of this stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: The color looks nothing like Mondstadt wolf fur, based on what the books say. Could it be that they're from somewhere else entirely?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hair looks different at every place on the body, same applies to wolves. You don't know where it's from...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But look at this—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Another hair. But what's that stuck to it?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It's the seed of a Wolfhook berry. Look, there are little hooks on the seed.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: The only places this grows in Mondstadt are Wolvendom and Brightcrown Canyon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it's Wolvendom wolves after all?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: From that area, yes, but it could be that there are other wolf packs encroaching on their territory.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: This doesn't tell us everything, but it does give us a strong lead. Enough to start investigating.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I'll go and see to the villagers before we head off.

choices.text: Is there something special about it?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: How is your investigation coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha— You're standing!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: I have recovered, thankfully. I managed to claw my way back out of the depths of hell.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: So, Knights of Favonius — what have you found out?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: From inspecting wolf fur left at the scene, we can tell that the wolves came from Wolvendom. Beyond that, we don't know anything.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But please remain calm. I will head to Wolvendom shortly and get to the bottom of this.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius will not allow this danger to continue any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Good. Better late than never I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How rude!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: In the meantime, we'll just have to keep dealing with this on our own.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Please, don't do anything stupid.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Hah! We do things a bit differently around here, you lot from the order probably aren't used to it. They will pay for what they've done!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: It's awful, it really is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Their future outlook, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I agree.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Young people can be so impulsive sometimes. If it's not too much to ask, I hope you can keep an eye on them, stop them from getting into trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It's no trouble — that's what we're here for. Even though that guy really isn't much of a charmer.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Leave it to us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Off to Wolvendom we go!
